note: Seasonal reasons to go now, checked against official or organizer pages. Dates can change, so check the source before you go.

tags.about: Salmon return to local rivers and hatcheries in fall.
tags.label: SalmonRun

capilanoriver.why: Coho are returning now and Chinook come back in October and November. The Capilano River Hatchery has free underwater viewing windows (open 8am to 6pm in October).

capilanoriverhatchery.why: Coho are returning now and Chinook come back in October and November. The hatchery has viewing windows.

hydecreekhatchery.why: Chum return to Hyde Creek in October and November and coho in November. Park at Hyde Creek Recreation Centre and follow the creek trail, with lookouts and a footbridge, to the hatchery.

inletpark.why: Chum return to Noons Creek in October and November and coho in November. Family-friendly trails and a creekside boardwalk lead to the Noons Creek Hatchery next door.

kanaka.why: Chum and coho return to the creek in fall. The Return of the Salmon event at the Bell-Irving Hatchery is on Oct 18.

tynehead.why: Adult coho, chum and Chinook return to the Serpentine River here from October to December.

hoycreekhatchery.why: Chum return from early October to mid-November and coho from late October to mid-December. Salmon Come Home is on Oct 25.

hockadaypark.why: Chum return to the Coquitlam River from early October to mid-November and coho from late October to mid-December. There is a family-friendly viewing area by the water.

littlecampbellriverh.why: Coho, steelhead and chinook can be seen from October to January. A free, wheelchair accessible nature trail follows the river.

tags.about: Local ski hills open when the snow arrives.
tags.label: SkiSeasonSoon

cypress.why: Summer hiking is winding down and ski season is next. Projected opening is Nov 28, depending on snow. 2026/27 season passes are on sale.

grouse.why: Ski season is next. Projected opening is mid-December, depending on snow, and 2026/27 passes are on sale now.

mountseymourpark.why: Ski season is next. Mt Seymour is the family and beginner hill, with a projected opening of Dec 19, depending on snow.

tags.about: Holiday light displays open from early November.
tags.label: HolidayLights

bearcreek.why: Bear Creek Lights is a free light-display trail, Nov 6 to 20 (5-9pm, free timed tickets, closed Nov 11).

bvm.why: Festive Village puts holiday lights across the 10-acre outdoor museum from Nov 25 (2-9pm, free entry, carousel $2.86). Entry may be limited when it's busy.

capilano.why: Canyon Lights puts thousands of lights on the suspension bridge, treetops walk and cliffwalk from Nov 20.

towncentre.why: Lights at Lafarge is a free winter lights display around Lafarge Lake. It kicks off Nov 27 (5-8pm) with a fire and light show, and the lights are on 4-11pm daily.

vandusen.why: Festival of Lights has over a million lights across the garden from Nov 27 (4-10pm). Timed tickets are sold online only.
